title: Rotary joint: guaranteed velocity-error limit (high-gain observer)
answers: We only have the joint encoder, sampled at 1 kHz; the model is attached. The encoder error never exceeds 0.1 mrad. Unmodelled disturbance accelerations are bounded by 0.5 rad/s^2. The joint never moves faster than 4 rad/s, which is enforced by a hardware limiter in the drive. At start-up the angle is known to within 1 mrad.
The velocity estimate must be guaranteed to stay within 0.25 rad/s of the true velocity from 100 ms after start-up onward, for every admissible disturbance and noise.
note: the request deliberately omits the bound on the initial velocity error; the coordinator asks for it because a deadline is stated
